# Ajay Sachdev: Full Profile
> Finance & Operations Manager at a B2B tech scale-up. CIMA finalist (Strategic Case Study sat May 2026). Builds production AI systems, Power BI dashboards, and financial models. Python, TypeScript, SQL. Based in Cambridge, UK.

## Background
Ajay Sachdev grew up in a Sindhi family from Mumbai. His dad ran a textile business (est. 1988). After studying Financial Markets at Jai Hind College (2015-18) and earning a Chartered Wealth Management certification from AAFM, he worked in the family business, leading a vertical integration into garment manufacturing and building its direct-to-consumer website (uni-nation.in).

He moved to the UK for an MSc in Finance at Loughborough University (2020-21, 2:1), then joined a B2B tech scale-up in October 2021. He is now the sole finance & operations function, managing three entities across the UK, US, and Pakistan.

He sat the CIMA Strategic Case Study in May 2026 and serves as a School Governor at a 250-pupil primary school.

## Current Role: Finance & Operations Manager
- Sole finance & operations function across UK, US, Pakistan (3 entities)
- Board-level financial models and reporting
- Built 50+ Power BI dashboards as sole data analyst
- Manages 7 multi-currency bank accounts (GBP, USD, PKR)
- Produces management accounts, VAT returns, payroll
- Drafts contracts, NDAs, SoWs, supplier agreements
- Reduced WiFi costs 50%, electricity 74%, software 30%+
- Cut a core SaaS platform's cost 65% through a systematic audit
- Redesigned the contract format from 15 pages to 2 with hyperlinked terms; six-month stalls became one-week signings
- Saves 40+ hours/month through automation

## Projects

### OpsPilot: AI Executive Assistant
An AI assistant that lives in Microsoft Teams: reads 6,124+ SharePoint documents, pulls live Xero and HubSpot data, and drafts replies approved with one click. Runs 24/7 in production.
- 97,000 lines of code, 28 AI tools
- 100% search accuracy on a 50-query test suite
- Hybrid search (FAISS vector + BM25 keyword), reranking, sensitivity detection
- Daily automated briefings, deal-health scoring, decision journal
- Gemini primary with Claude fallback

### Trading Bot: Multi-Agent FTSE 100 System
An intraday trading system where four AI agents vote on every signal and a Risk Auditor holds an absolute veto.
- 4 agents: Orchestrator, Context Lead, Analyst, Risk Auditor (Claude-powered)
- Paper trading by design: 62 sessions, zero impulsive trades let through
- 7,000+ lines of Python across 33 files
- Hard safety rails in code, not prompts: GBP 750 max notional, 3% stop loss, 6% take profit, one position at a time, kill switch, end-of-day liquidation

### Uni-Nation Digital (uni-nation.in)
Website, inventory system and analytics for the family fabric business running since 1988.
- Inventory PWA (~22,000 lines) tracking roughly $2m of sales data, ~2,000 products, 650+ customers
- Voice stock entry in mixed Hindi-English: the parser understands thaan, taaka, metre and Hindi numbers, and corrects speech-to-text on fabric names
- Receivables tracking with WhatsApp follow-up generation

### WhatsApp Smart: Chrome Extension Prototype
Adds scheduling, AI replies, tone adjustment and group summaries to WhatsApp Web. Privacy-first: messages never leave the browser. 10 features built; unreleased prototype.

### SCS Cockpit: Exam Study Engine
A zero-dependency browser study tool he built to prepare for his own CIMA Strategic Case Study: timed drills, spaced repetition, 5-dimension debrief scoring. 4,200 lines of vanilla JavaScript.
